meta.title: The PR line shows Ordered after the award's PO is created

plan.title: Verify PR line becomes ordered after PO creation

args.goal: open Purchase Requisitions on the buyer portal, search for the PR used by the awarded PR-based event, open its line details, and verify that the line shows Completed or the ordered quantity with the generated PO number linked

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for inspecting an existing PR line after PO creation; this buyer-side action performs the required navigation and observation.
Confirm the resulting PR details screen has no loading, error, crash, or raw-data presentation problems after the status and PO-link check.
